# Líbere

> > Líbere offers flexible serviced apartments, aparthotels, and hotels across Spain (Pamplona, Valencia, Seville, Barcelona, Córdoba, Granada, Vitoria, Ciudad Real) and Italy (Rome) with mid-stay and monthly rental options.

Líbere specializes in furnished accommodations with flexible terms, digital check-in, and no long-term commitments. Properties include Líbere Pamplona Yamaguchi near Yamaguchi Park and Clínica Universidad de Navarra, plus locations in major European cities for business travelers, digital nomads, and groups seeking 1+ month stays.

## Key Topics

- Aparthotels and serviced apartments
- Mid-stay and monthly rentals (1+ months)
- Flexible accommodation with no long-term commitment
- Furnished apartments with digital check-in
- Spain locations: Pamplona, Valencia, Seville, Barcelona, Córdoba, Granada, Vitoria, Ciudad Real
- Rome accommodation in San Lorenzo neighborhood
- Líbere Pamplona Yamaguchi near Yamaguchi Park
- Líbere Pamplona Universidad near University of Navarra and Clínica Universidad de Navarra
- Business travel and corporate housing
- Group travel accommodations
- Flexible cancellation policies
- Longer stays with monthly pricing

## Core Accommodation Services

- [Líbere | Apartments, Aparthotels and Hotels | Book now](https://www.staylibere.com/): Homepage for Líbere serviced apartments across London, Rome, Barcelona, Seville
- [Mid stay accommodation | Líbere](https://www.staylibere.com/en/mid-stay): Monthly apartment rentals (1+ month) with flexible terms at Líbere locations
